name: MAX30102
title: Pulse oximeter and heart-rate sensor (I2C)
libraries: SparkFun MAX3010x Pulse and Proximity Sensor Library
notes: The SparkFun MAX3010x library drives the MAX30102 (use MAX30105.h).
Heart rate: checkForBeat() from heartRate.h finds a beat in the IR samples; the example averages the last 4 beats.
